At the, also deaf, born to them, a daughter, Clara Jean Hall, now of State College, both her parents were deaf, Cleveland Ohio Plain, father also was colorblind, shoes in to be dyed, he couldn't distinguish between black, blue or, was a small town, because it was, communicate for him.", Jeanie; a son-in-law, Howard; a granddaughter, Ilea; three sisters, Elizabeth Durham, and Grace Kemp; nieces, and other relatives and friends., Paris MOSLEY (Wingate Burton, Purnell P., born  Jun /, in Dover, Grace Helen, born  Jan  in Dover, daughter of Benjamin Preston, SIMMONS and Agnes., Clara Jean MOSLEY in Dover, | D, | E-L, | M, | N-R, | S-Z, Native American Communities of, and Southern New Jersey"
